xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4730: gstack pack: opt-in browser/design/PDF runtime so qa, browse and design skills can mount

plan.title: gstack pack: opt-in browser/design/PDF runtime so qa, browse and design skills can mount
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: 40 files_scope entries: 19 are in a different repository (the eltmon/gstack fork, prefixed gstack-fork/, including its test ratchet registries), and 21 are Overdeck files, of which 8 are test files, 3 are docs and 1 is the live checkpoint doc; the Overdeck source surface is 9 files in src/lib/skill-packs, src/lib/skill-overrides and src/cli/commands. The fork's --pack-browser contract and the Overdeck consent flow must ship together for the live acceptance run, and a sibling issue in this tracker could not carry a PR for another repo (same shape as PAN-4727).

narratives.Problem: PAN-4727 mounts gstack through a network-free pack mode, so the 21 skills that call gstack's compiled browse, design and make-pdf binaries ($B/$D/$P) are classified needs-binary and never mount; the operator wanted qa to work. A naive build (scripts/build.sh, setup) re-renders skills with the ~/.claude install root, writes ~/.gstack and ~/.cache/ms-playwright, and lets skills self-install.
narratives.Proposal: Fork (eltmon/gstack, branch overdeck/pack-browser): a separately invoked setup --pack-browser R --pack-browser-cache C step that runs bun install --production --frozen-lockfile, the five bun build --compile lines and bun x playwright install chromium with caches under C, plus markers and a pack env helper so compiled binaries, the daemon and gstack-browser-ensure find the state root and Chromium without launch env, guards so a render never self-installs, and a ~/.gstack doc rewrite. Overdeck: a second consent (pan skills pack browser gstack on|off, add --browser) recorded as browser: true in the registry, readiness derived from R/.gstack-pack-browser.json, update/sync rebuild, catalog/launch mount the new browser (9) and browser-opt-in (9) classes only when ready, daemon reporting on remove/off, docs, and an isolated live run of /gstack:qa-only.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Running gstack's scripts/build.sh, CSO, build-node-server.sh, font installs, --with-deps or any system package install
- Mounting open-gstack-browser, pair-agent, setup-browser-cookies or any PAN-4727 excluded skill
- Setting any gstack or Playwright env var in Overdeck launches (markers only)
- Killing browse daemons or deleting project .gstack/ dirs or /tmp/browse-* files
- Garbage-collecting old Chromium revisions inside packs/gstack/browser/playwright
- Dashboard UI for the browser runtime
- A Codex-specific build or Windows support for the browser step
- Merging the fork PR or any contact with garrytan/gstack
- Building browser runtime during catalog reads or launches

autoDecisions.summary: A1: Build the browser runtime inside the existing render R, with bun cache and Chromium in ~/.overdeck/packs/gstack/browser/
autoDecisions.rationale: Rendered skills already resolve $B/$D/$P to R/<tool>/dist/<bin>, so no new path rewrite is needed, and every byte stays under packs/gstack so remove leaves nothing.

autoDecisions.summary: A2: The fork step runs the compile lines directly and never scripts/build.sh
autoDecisions.rationale: build.sh re-renders every skill for all hosts without the install root (gstack-host-renders.sh selects all in R), which would undo the pack render.

autoDecisions.summary: A3: canary is browser-opt-in although the fork reads it as monitoring-only
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body names canary with the deploy skills as opt-in; the issue is the authoritative input.

autoDecisions.summary: A4: open-gstack-browser, pair-agent and setup-browser-cookies are excluded, not opt-in
autoDecisions.rationale: They read the operator's real browser cookies and keychain, expose the browser through an ngrok tunnel, or write ~/.gstack and ~/.codex outside the pack, which breaks the issue's clean-removal requirement.

autoDecisions.summary: A5: Consent is stored as browser: true in skills.packs.gstack; readiness is derived from R/.gstack-pack-browser.json
autoDecisions.rationale: Consent is an operator decision like the trusted commit; built state is derivable, and Overdeck stores no status it can derive.

autoDecisions.summary: A6: Markers and a fork pack env helper instead of Overdeck launch env
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4727 chose markers (D2) and lists launch env vars as a non-goal; markers also work for hand-run binaries and every harness.

autoDecisions.summary: A7: CLI is a new verb pan skills pack browser <id> [on|off] plus add --browser with a second confirmation
autoDecisions.rationale: updatePack returns early for an unchanged commit, so a flag on update cannot enable the runtime for an already-added pack; the issue asks for a separately consented step.

autoDecisions.summary: A8: browser off deletes and re-renders the trusted render and deletes the browser cache
autoDecisions.rationale: Re-rendering is offline and fast and is the only way to leave R identical in kind to a fresh add without ~572 MB of node_modules.

autoDecisions.summary: A9: The consent preview lists direct production dependencies plus a lockfile line and the Chromium line
autoDecisions.rationale: Satisfies 'every download listed' at the level the operator can review; the full transitive list is the frozen bun.lock, which the line names.

autoDecisions.summary: A10: Browse daemons are reported with a kill command on remove and off, never killed
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches PAN-4727 D9 (print, never delete project files) and the repo invariant that runaway processes are surfaced, not killed; the daemon exits after 30 idle minutes.
